name: goal-decomposer
force_prompt: OK, given everything I've told you, please draft my sprint plan now: a one-line theme, 4-6 concrete goals split into work and personal, and an accountability setup.

judge_dimensions.name: theme_quality
judge_dimensions.description: Theme is a concrete one-line north star that could fit on a sticky note — not a mission statement, not a vague aspiration.

judge_dimensions.name: goal_specificity
judge_dimensions.description: Goals are concrete, finishable in two weeks, and measurable. They are not vague aspirations like 'learn more about X' without a finishing condition.

judge_dimensions.name: work_personal_balance
judge_dimensions.description: There is a clear split between work goals (advancing the theme) and personal goals (about how the person wants to live), and both feel substantive.

judge_dimensions.name: accountability_design
judge_dimensions.description: The accountability setup is lightweight and concrete: who to tell, what cadence, what to send (kickoff + mid + end). Not generic advice to 'find an accountability partner'.

judge_dimensions.name: overall
judge_dimensions.description: Which response would actually help the user execute a useful two-week sprint?
